Hey <@&1424461167883194418> — 58 merges this week. The garden acquired several new species.

## Weekly Update - 2026-07-26

### 🌱 Community models are becoming a proper publishing surface
- New community image endpoints, publisher allowlist/activation controls, separate titles + descriptions, and capped community-model prices.
- App submission is simpler, and the model catalog now has clearer human-readable descriptions instead of a decorative pile of IDs.

### 🖼️ Image + media shelf got larger
- Added `Laguna S 2.1`, `Recraft` vector generation, `Grok Imagine` defaulting to 2K, and `Lyria 3 Clip` music.
- `NanoBanana`, `NanoBanana 2`, `NanoBanana 2 Lite`, `NanoBanana Pro`, `Seedream 4.5 Pro`, and Grok media routes now run through OpenRouter.

### 💬 More models, one endpoint
- `Gemini Flash Lite 3.5`, `LongCat 2.0`, `Claude Opus 5` via `claude-large`, `CSM 1B` speech, and Arika chat are live. Google text models now route through OpenRouter too.

### 🔧 Less mysterious failure
- Replicate capacity errors now return `503`, timed-out predictions get cancelled, reference-image downloads are validated, and Vast/Flux/Klein deployments gained queue and GPU-OOM guardrails. Software has been gently persuaded to stop wandering off.

Docs: https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations • API reference: https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/blob/master/APIDOCS.md
